algorithm.title: Carpal Tunnel Diagnosis and Treatment Algorithm.

cell.label: CTS suspected (numbness/tingling/pain in thumb, median 4th finger; hypoalgesia; positive or probable hand diagram results; and/or weak thumb abduction strength).
If symptoms are not classic, consider diagnostic electromyelogram or ultrasound. CTS confirmed?
Trial of nocturnal wrist splinting in neutral position.
If no improvement in 1 month, consider CTS injection or oral steroids.
If no response, consider yoga or carpal bone immobilization, or obtain EMG to confirm diagnosis and refer for possible surgical decompression if abnormal.
